title: 理解一条响应式数据流
source:
root = Column({"id":"root","children":["intro","details"]}, [n1, n12])
n1 = LingUI_Section({"id":"intro","label":"响应式编程","title":"数据如何流向订阅者","description":"先描述数据处理过程，在订阅发生时启动工作。","children":["concepts","code"]}, [n2, n11])
n2 = LingUI_Grid({"id":"concepts","maxColumns":2,"children":["source-card","consumer-card"]}, [n3, n7])
n3 = Card({"id":"source-card","variant":"soft","child":"source"}, [n4])
n4 = Column({"id":"source","children":["source-title","source-body"]}, [n5, n6])
n5 = Text({"id":"source-title","variant":"h3","text":"发布者"}, [])
n6 = Text({"id":"source-body","text":"按需求发出数据，或发出完成与错误信号。"}, [])
n7 = Card({"id":"consumer-card","variant":"soft","child":"consumer"}, [n8])
n8 = Column({"id":"consumer","children":["consumer-title","consumer-body"]}, [n9, n10])
n9 = Text({"id":"consumer-title","variant":"h3","text":"订阅者"}, [])
n10 = Text({"id":"consumer-body","text":"声明需求并接收结果，用背压协调消费速度。"}, [])
n11 = LingUI_CodeBlock({"id":"code","language":"java","label":"Reactor 示例","code":"Flux.just(1, 2, 3)\n    .map(value -> value * 2)\n    .subscribe(System.out::println);"}, [])
n12 = LingUI_Collapse({"id":"details","title":"查看信号说明","expanded":{"path":"/open"},"child":"answer"}, [n13])
n13 = LingUI_KeyValue({"id":"answer","entries":[{"label":"onNext","value":"传递一个数据元素。"},{"label":"onComplete","value":"表示数据已经全部发送。"},{"label":"onError","value":"表示流因错误终止。"}]}, [])
